summary: Long row of angle bays beside a sports field, no homes within 48 m.
reasons: Dense row of cars parked along edge

drivers.seclusion: Playing field and tree line to the west, university warehouse and yard to the east; houses 48 m or more away at the north end.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; angle bays on the west edge, with a dirt strip behind the cars, hold a long row of vehicles.
drivers.traffic: Light campus traffic; junction at the north end and a depot opposite.
drivers.convention: Signed 4P angle parking in the Traffic Area; around 30 cars parked, so a van blends in.

flags: Signed Traffic Area restriction Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, Feb-Nov
sun_shade: Open to the sky; a line of trees on the west gives afternoon shade.

best_section.where: west edge of Walcott Street, in the angle bays beside the playing field
